content: Decision: Store three HashMap<Vec<u8>, i32> caches (one per BCF_DT_*) inside HeaderView. Built once at construction from the hdr->id[] arrays. All 4 callers (name2rid, tag_type, name_to_id, sample_to_id) will use the cache instead of FFI. O(1) lookup, no khash dependency, fully safe Rust.
